statements.action_statement: Install Alpine official OpenSSL 3.5.9-r1 from edge/main. Alpine aports commit 5e6d18a5ba2eec060b34a671a43ee54a5e72714a backports this CVE fix: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/5e6d18a5ba2eec060b34a671a43ee54a5e72714a/main/openssl/APKBUILD . Stable-distro scanner data does not yet record the edge backport. Only the exact r1 binary packages and listed stable distro identities are covered; r0, other versions and all other vulnerabilities remain blocking.
